tools.name: generate_escort_cards
tools.description: Use this when the user wants escort cards (flat cards that tell each guest their table, often with meal choice) or a printable table plan list from a guest list. Convert the guest list into guests (name, table, meal). Returns flat 3.5 x 2 in cards, 10 per Letter or A4 page (or 105 x 74 mm, 8 per A4)
